name: Air cushioning
summary: A sealed bag of gas in the midsole of a shoe, which gives a spring under the heel without a heavy foam.
how: Seal a bag of gas in a film of polyurethane.
Set the bag in the heel of the foam midsole.
Show the bag in a window of the midsole.

origin.note: Frank Rudy patents a sole with a sealed gas unit, and the first shoe appears in 1978.

adoptions.via: A running shoe is the first to carry the sealed air unit in its heel.
The Air Jordan 1 shows the air unit as a mark of the signed shoe.
